name: Non-deleted clients assigned to an inactive IM
rule_text: Flag every non-deleted client whose IM_CODE matches an adviser with IS_ACTIVE = FALSE. Include CLIENT_ID, IM_CODE, adviser name, CLIENT_STATUS and IS_ACTIVE in the result.

name: Active clients with zero or negative AUM
rule_text: Flag every client with CLIENT_STATUS is ACTIVE, IS_DELETED = FALSE, and AUM that is null, zero, or negative. Include CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_STATUS, and AUM.
